campaign: GUI capability roadmap: flat conversation workflow, reliable execution controls and verified mobile use
doctrine:
Current owner direction: merge master into professional_overgo_gui while retaining this plan, optimize the GUI roadmap, and continue its implementation. This resumes the previously stopped GUI work. Work exclusively in this worktree; a later GUI-to-master publication still requires separate owner authorization.

Preserve the accepted conversation-first design: flat messages/lists/separators, no cards, independently scrolling messages, reachable Send/Stop, one compact model selector with explicit details, mobile navigation drawer, Settings on demand and status only for relevant work/failure/required action. Retain the existing workbench and embedded same-origin client, CSP and authenticated shared transport; no new framework, external asset dependency or parallel state backend. Apply Impeccable guidance to clarity, focus, typography and touch behavior.

Prioritize preventing lost work and stopping the correct execution before adding navigation and convenience features. Responses, lineage, operations, artifacts and decisions remain owned by the server; browser drafts/settings are scoped to conversation and recipe and exclude secrets. Distinguish explicit Stop from disconnect, resume from retry, and branch creation from mutation. Reuse master's transaction-scoped store/workbench owners, durable evidence handles, physical-resource admission and abandoned-admission recovery.

The existing 1dd62c8f fixes and browser tests remain regression floors. New named tests in future rows are implementation obligations, not present evidence. Require assertions on actual user actions and request/terminal state, not screenshots or builds alone. Use fixtures for focused tests and the full model lane for final signoff. Scope OVERGO_DATA_ROOT to commands needing canonical fixtures. Full gates covering inherited audio/corpus acceptance use OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE=C:/Users/jeffm/overgo/overgodb-store as the existing read-only reference; keep source changes in this GUI worktree. Chromium emulation does not satisfy physical-device/Safari/screen-reader acceptance; record missing hardware or supported modality evidence as outstanding. Do not reintroduce arbitrary source-size ceilings in place of functional checks.

This is the sole live plan for this worktree. Only professional_overgo_gui-owned rows are local work. Retained master-owned identities are external coordination references, not a copy of master's current execution queue: master at 4eadd204 owns validation-batch promotion, E4B validation, model regression, memory/decode work, benchmarks, native audio and final model acceptance. Preserve their existing step identities, dependencies and verifier lower bounds; reconcile their historical detail in master before execution. The 27B full benchmark remains operator-launched. Gate commits through the existing plan owner; completed work belongs in Git/OvergoDB, and owner stop conditions persist.

Master 4eadd204 already contains the reviewed GUI baseline through 0219c646. Preserve its persisted model-identity memo, task-filtered generation discovery, browser source-identity validation, CPU audio adapters and exact checkpoint recovery. CPU audio acceptance does not establish native streaming or a GUI training workflow. Keep the four inherited audio/training boundary obligations under audio-staged-surface; do not import master's plan.

items.title: Edit, retry, regenerate and export conversation turns without losing their history

steps.title: Edit, retry, regenerate and export conversation turns without losing their history
steps.rationale: Reuse stored response lineage and previous_response_id. Add explicit edit-and-resend and assistant regeneration that create identifiable branches rather than overwriting durable messages; expose branch selection where required. Provide copy and Markdown export for the selected conversation with clear attachment references. Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve the original on failed regeneration. Do not confuse retry after a refused request with resuming an already running response. Add TestWebUIBrowserConversationActions covering lineage, branch reopening, model compatibility, stop/retry, clipboard failure and exported content.

items.title: Make attachment intake and modality controls usable on a phone

steps.title: Make attachment intake and modality controls usable on a phone
steps.rationale: Retain the accepted decoding waits, file refusals, authenticated previews/downloads and generated-media reuse. Extend the same composer with clear per-file read/upload/progress/refusal states, retry/remove actions, capability-driven input guidance and bounded previews. Keep declared media controls reachable above the composer without consuming the conversation; use native phone file/media pickers and expose only declared modalities. Preserve media/recipe identity through reuse and model changes. Add TestWebUIBrowserAttachmentWorkflow for multi-file selection, paste, rejected/corrupt files, upload failure/cancel, protected media and phone keyboard-height layout.

items.title: Keep conversation and workbench actions responsive during background work

steps.title: Keep conversation and workbench actions responsive during background work
steps.rationale: Master 4eadd204 includes transaction-scoped workbench/store access, retained evidence handles, persisted model identities and task-filtered generation discovery. Keep these implemented improvements as regression floors; do not rebuild their memo/cache owners. Build on those owners: Library intake, generation and model switching must coexist with reading/composing and show accurate state when another process commits or an action fails. Preserve draft and selection through catalog refreshes. Use one compact user-relevant activity entry with result navigation, cancellation or required action; keep idle operational space absent. Reuse existing operation routes and durable receipts. Add TestWebUIBrowserBackgroundWork with held operations and concurrent store updates to prove navigation/composing remain available, failures recover, and completed outputs remain findable. The plan-commit browser run exposed a concurrent GPU reservation as a generic child-server startup failure. Surface resource contention as a clear busy/wait/retry state, preserve the draft and model selection, and put technical diagnostics behind explicit details. Add a controlled busy-admission case; never bypass resource ownership.

steps.rationale: Each preceding browser test must emit its named journey marker after asserting behavior. Run the full real-model lane once for this acceptance, inspect desktop/phone light/dark captures and verify the real-device evidence. Include cold start, model/key setup, multi-turn chat, stop/disconnect/recovery, reload, history/branches, attachment reuse and Library/background operations. Keep credentials and model metadata out of the primary conversation. Report tested models, browsers, devices and unsupported/missing modality cases explicitly; missing supported evidence cannot count as complete.
